title: resilient-lane-reshuffle-and-syncless-retry-to-mitigate-tp-stragglers
author: Evelyn Chan
description: Context: In production multi-GPU tensor-parallel runs we've observed tail latency variance caused by transient peer stalls and rare NCCL retries when a single rank experiences scheduling jitter. That jitter cascades through our lane-based collective scheduler, causing small but frequent KV-cache miss amplification and microbatch reorders which reduce sustained throughput for long sequences. Motivation: Reduce straggler impact without disabling asynchronous launches or adding heavy global synchronizations. Goal is to allow adaptive, localized remediation: detect a problematic lane/peer, reshuffle lane-to-peer mapping opportunistically, and perform syncless retry windows for small transfers while preserving overall stream parallelism and kernel coalescing.
description_details: This PR implements three coordinated changes: 1) Lane Reshuffle Map: a lightweight reshuffle layer in the lane allocator that can remap tensor-slice lanes between physical peers when the allocator observes repeated NCCL stall/timeout heuristics, with a bounded reshuffle rate and deterministic seed so behavior is replayable. 2) Syncless Retry Window: a per-lane small-duration retry mechanic that reissues a collective within a microsecond window using an alternative NCCL stream and backoff counters, avoiding a full host-level barrier. Retries are limited by a per-request credit to prevent runaway duplicates. 3) KV-cache fence hints + continuous-batch alignment: when a reshuffle happens we emit KV-cache fence hints so downstream microbatches can realign their prefix caches to the new lane mapping and avoid duplicate prefetches. The allocator also biases grouping for continuous batching to prefer reshuffle-safe microbatches for the next N requests.

patch_summary: Added a lane reshuffle mechanism (configurable threshold and cooldown), implemented a syncless retry window with per-lane credits, KV-cache fence hint propagation and alignment logic, surfaced metrics (lane_reshuffle_count, lane_retry_count, kv_fence_issued), and end-to-end tests plus docs. Conservatively guarded behind a runtime flag 'TP_RESHUFFLE_ENABLED' default false in release builds.
review_conversation: Miguel Soto (reviewer): Could you explain the failure mode that triggers reshuffle? I'm worried about oscillation in noisy environments.

Evelyn Chan (author): We trigger only after 3 consecutive peer timeouts within a 2s sliding window + NCCL ERROR retry observed. A cooldown of 30s per-lane prevents oscillation. Added deterministic random seed to avoid nondeterministic reshuffle order; see lane_allocator.cpp:ReshuffleState.
Asha Patel (reviewer): The syncless retry duplicates may affect at-least-once semantics for some internal control messages. How do we ensure idempotency?
Asha_reply: We only allow syncless retry for collective payloads used in KV prefetch lane-aligned traffic (the requests we control). The collector uses sequence ids and a short-lived dedupe cache keyed by (lane, seq_id, attempt_window) which is bounded. Not used for user-visible RPCs. See syncless_retry.cc comment block.

ci_checks: integration-tp: pass (640s) - perf run with 8xA100 simulated nodes
benchmark-regression: warn (throughput -0.4% on p99 microbatch case) - accepted after runbook rationale
performance_notes: In internal perf runs with synthetic long-sequence workloads (seq_len 4096, batch 4), median throughput improved +3.7% and p99 latency reduced by 18% in runs that had injected peer jitter. On steady-state no-jitter runs we observe negligible change (+0.2% throughput), the benchmark-regression warning was due to a microbatch alignment overhead in one configuration and is gated by the flag.
testing: Unit tests added for reshuffle decision logic, syncless retry backoff, and KV-fence propagation. Integration test runs cover: 1) single-node forced peer stalls -> reshuffle trigger and throughput recovery, 2) multi-node transient stalls where reshuffle cooldown prevents oscillation, 3) KV-cache alignment verification across microbatch boundaries.
docs_and_runbook: Added docs/runbooks/tp-straggler-mitigation.md describing when to enable, tuning knobs (RESHUFFLE_THRESHOLD, RESHUFFLE_COOLDOWN_S, RETRY_WINDOW_US, RETRY_CREDIT_PER_LANE), observability dashboard suggestions (lane_reshuffle_count, lane_retry_count, kv_fence_issued) and rollback steps.
release_notes: TP lane reshuffle (opt-in): reduces tail latency for tensor-parallel workloads suffering transient peer stalls by opportunistic lane remapping and short syncless retries. Default off. See runbook for tuning and safety considerations.
post_merge_tasks: Enable feature flag in staging for one week
Add recording to SRE runbook for incident detection using lane_reshuffle_count
notes: We intentionally kept the default disabled because reshuffling changes the mapping semantics; ops should enable after validating with canary traffic. Follow-up work: explore multi-lane coordinated reshuffle for large tensor cross-slices and adding kernel-level affinity hints to reduce kernel warmup costs.
